title: Nick And Kits!
description: A lightweight server utility mod for Minecraft, adding operator-controlled nickname and kit commands perfect for recording servers.
body:
## Nick And Kits! 

Ops can change what another player's name looks like in-game. Either set one yourself with /nick, or just use /randomnick and let the mod pick something random. Great for when you don't want real usernames showing up on camera. It doesn't mess with their actual account or anything, just changes the name people see in the world.
Kits
Ops can create item loadouts and give them out with a single command. No menus, no GUI, nothing like that — just type /kit give and the stuff shows up in their inventory. You can give it to one person or just do @a and blast everyone at once. Super useful for getting players geared up fast without killing the vibe of a session.
all of this is OP only. Regular players can't touch any of it.

## Commands

**/nick <player> <nickname> — Change another player's name (OP only)
/randomnick <player> — Slap a random nickname on someone (OP only)
/kit create <name> — Make a kit (OP only)
/kit give <name> <player|@a> — Give a kit to someone or everyone (OP only)**

## Installation

Grab Fabric Loader if you don't have it
Throw the jar in your /mods folder
Boot up your server and you're done

No config, no setup, nothing to figure out. It just works.
